frequency_question: How often does Congress successfully muster the will to pass a joint resolution of disapproval against major executive-branch nuclear or strategic agreements?
membership_rule: Includes formal 123 agreements and major contentious arms sales subject to congressional disapproval statutes; excludes routine non-contested trade or technical renewals.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major historical instances identified where congressional fractions attempted to block executive nuclear/strategic compacts with Middle Eastern partners.
known_gaps: Excludes minor or withdrawn resolutions that never reached formal floor votes.
skeleton: Legislative disapproval attempts against major executive foreign/nuclear agreements since the Arms Export Control Act and Atomic Energy Act review procedures were established.
multiplier: 5 historical challenge attempts / 5 total major contested Middle East nuclear/arms initiatives where disapproval was formally introduced = historical override/passage failure rate of principal will at the congressional level.
validity_reason: Constitutional balance of power and statutory review frameworks for nuclear agreements remain stable over multi-decadal horizons.
